responsibility: This file implements the IPA pass for multi-versioned functions created from target_clones and related multiple-target attributes. It parses and validates clone attribute lists, creates target-specific clones and version chains in the callgraph, synthesizes and wires dispatcher/ifunc resolver functions through target hooks, redirects callgraph edges and address references to dispatchers or matching clones, and retargets clone-to-clone calls when attributes match. Its responsibility is callgraph-level construction and redirection of target-specific function multiversioning, not target-specific resolver body generation itself.
